'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Two senior leaders of the [[Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan|Tehrik-i-Taliban]] and three other [[militant]]s are killed during two separate security operations in [[North Waziristan]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/1/25/pakistan-says-pakistani-taliban-commanders-killed-in-northwest (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on retail]]
***British multinational retailer [[Debenhams]] announces that it will permanently close all of its [[brick and mortar]] stores in the United Kingdom, with the loss of 12,000 jobs, after being bought by online fashion retailer [[Boohoo.com]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/business-and-tech/20210125-debenhams-shuts-stores-costing-12-000-jobs (AFP via RFI)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]], [[COVID-19 recession]], [[Economy of South Korea]]
***[[South Korea]] records its worst annual [[economic growth]] since 1998 following the [[1997 Asian financial crisis|Asian financial crisis]]. Its [[gross domestic product]] [[Recession|contracted]] 1.0 percent in 2020 from 2019. [https://www.businesstimes.com.sg/government-economy/south-korea-posts-worst-growth-in-two-decades (AFP via ''Business Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2020–21 South-West Indian Ocean cyclone season]]
**[[Cyclone Eloise]] leaves at least thirteen people dead and more than 8,000 people homeless after making landfall in central [[Mozambique]]. Major flooding is also reported in [[Eswatini]], [[South Africa]] and [[Zimbabwe]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-africa-eloise/thirteen-dead-thousands-homeless-in-southern-africa-after-storm-eloise-idUSKBN29U1MH?il=0 (Reuters)]
*Nine of the [[gold mining in China|miners]] who went missing during a [[Mining accident|mine collapse]] in [[Qixia, Shandong|Qixia]], [[Shandong]], [[China]], are found dead by [[Emergency medical services|rescue worker]]s. Yesterday another miner was found dead, bringing the death toll to 10, while eleven others were rescued alive. Another miner is still missing. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-china-55793578 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[501.V2 variant]]
*****[[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]] signs an order banning travel from [[South Africa]] due to fears of the 501.V2 variant; the ban is expected to take effect on January 30. Additionally, Biden also extends travel restrictions to [[Brazil]], the [[United Kingdom]], the  [[Republic of Ireland]], and other [[Europe]]an countries, which were expected to expire tomorrow under an executive order signed by former [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/trafficandcommuting/biden-travel-ban/2021/01/25/f10084b4-5f1f-11eb-afbe-9a11a127d146_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
*****[[California]] [[Governor of California|Governor]] [[Gavin Newsom]] lifts the regional [[stay-at-home order]] in all areas statewide, including three areas where [[Intensive care unit|ICU]] capacity remains under 15%. [https://abc7.com/governor-gavin-newsom-coronavirus-lifts-stay-at-home-order-california-restaurant-association-covid/9997141 (KABC-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Minnesota]], [[Lineage B.1.1.248]]
*****[[Minnesota]] reports the first [[United States|U.S.]] case of the new variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] found in [[Brazil]]. The patient is a [[Minneapolis–Saint Paul|Twin Cities]] resident who traveled to Brazil. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/01/25/minnesota-confirms-first-known-us-case-of-more-contagious-covid-variant-originally-found-in-brazil.html (CNBC)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nevada]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[Nevada]] reports their first case of the B.1.1.7 strain of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] in a person with no recent travel history. [https://apnews.com/article/public-health-las-vegas-nevada-coronavirus-pandemic-reno-ab1c96cd0c84ca3414a1e0561d1692cd (AP)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Virginia]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[Virginia]] reports their first case of the UK variant of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]] in a person from [[Northern Virginia]] with no recent travel history. [https://richmond.com/news/state-and-regional/first-case-of-highly-contagious-uk-covid-variant-found-in-virginia/article_6b3d5341-b820-5a79-ae63-da0ce8a48cdb.html (''Richmond Times-Dispatch'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ontario]]
*****[[Premier of Ontario|Ontario Premier]] [[Doug Ford]] announces that the second state of emergency in the [[Ontario|province]] will be extended to February 8. [https://www.cp24.com/news/ford-government-extends-state-of-emergency-coronavirus-stay-at-home-order-for-additional-14-days-1.5281195 (CP24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]]
****[[Mexico]]'s richest person and billionaire [[Carlos Slim]] tests positive for [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/kerryadolan/2021/01/25/billionaire-carlos-slim-mexicos-richest-person-diagnosed-with-covid-19/ (''Forbes'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[Spain]] reports a record 93,822 new confirmed cases over the weekend, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 2,593,582. [https://www.eldiario.es/sociedad/espana-suma-93-822-nuevos-contagios-peor-semana-inicio-pandemia-incidencia-roza-900-casos_1_7158267.html (elDiario)]
****The [[Moncloa Chief of Staff|Prime Minister's Chief of Staff]] [[Iván Redondo]] tests positive for the COVID-19. [https://www.lavanguardia.com/politica/20210125/6197961/ivan-redondo-presidencia-psoe-positivo-covid.html (''La Vanguardia'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]], [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****[[Austria]] begins to require people aged 14 or older to wear [[FFP2]] masks in shops, pharmacies and hospitals, as well as on public transport. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210125-ffp2-masks-become-mandatory-in-austrian-shops-transport (France 24)] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Netherlands]], [[2021 Dutch curfew riots]], [[social impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****More than 180 people were arrested in 10 [[Netherlands|Dutch]] cities as protesters against the curfew and [[COVID-19 lockdown|lockdown]] clashed with riot [[Law enforcement in the Netherlands|law enforcement]] overnight for a third night in a row. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-55799919 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]]
****[[Ukraine]] reopens schools, restaurants, and gyms as a tough lockdown aimed to prevent a new wave of COVID-19 was ended. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-ukraine-lockdown/ukraine-completes-tough-covid-lockdown-with-optimistic-expectations-idUSKBN29U0RE (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bahrain]]
****[[Bahrain]] approves the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca vaccine]] for emergency use in the country. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/1/25/bahrain-approves-astrazeneca-oxford-covid-vaccine (Al Jazeera)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong]]
****[[Hong Kong]] approves the [[BioNTech]] [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] for emergency use in the city. [https://www.thestandard.com.hk/breaking-news/section/4/164189/HK-approves-BioNtech-vaccines (''The Standard'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports 9,994 new cases and 10,678 recoveries in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of recoveries to 809,488. [https://health.detik.com/berita-detikhealth/d-5347772/rekor-10678-pasien-covid-19-ri-sembuh-dalam-sehari-ini-sebarannya (detikHealth)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****[[Turkey]] receives 6.5 million doses of the [[Sinovac Biotech]] [[CoronaVac|vaccine]]. [https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/65-million-doses-of-chinese-vaccine-arrive-in-turkey/news (''Daily Sabah'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****The [[Therapeutic Goods Administration]] approves the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|Pfizer–BioNTech vaccine]] for use in [[Australia]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-01-25/pfizer-covid-19-vaccine-approved-australia-tga/13087990 (ABC Australia)]
***[[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]], [[501.V2 variant]]
****[[Australia]] suspends their travel bubble with [[New Zealand]] for the next 72 hours after New Zealand's first community case in months was confirmed to be of the 501.V2 variant from [[South Africa]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-55791857 (BBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Zimbabwe]]
***[[Zimbabwe]] surpasses 1,000 deaths from COVID-19. [https://www.sowetanlive.co.za/news/africa/2021-01-25-zimbabwe-covid-19-deaths-pass-1000-as-infections-surge/ (Sowetan Live)]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Moderna]] says that their vaccine would work against the [[Variants of SARS-CoV-2|new variants]] found in [[South Africa]] and the [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/uk-health-coronavirus-moderna/moderna-says-it-believes-vaccine-will-work-against-new-variants-idUSKBN29U2N4 (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Greek–Turkish relations]], [[Aegean dispute]], 2020–2021 East Mediterranean crisis
**The [[Government of Greece|Greek]] and [[Government of Turkey|Turkish governments]] conduct the two countries' first direct dialogue regarding the dispute since 2016. [https://www.ibtimes.com/greece-turkey-hold-first-crisis-talks-2016-3129866 (AFP via ''IBTimes'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on religion]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Nevada]]
**The [[Supreme Court of the United States|United States Supreme Court]] declines to hear a case from the Calvary Chapel Dayton Valley, a church in [[Dayton, Nevada]], that faces restrictions from [[Governor of Nevada|Governor]] [[Steve Sisolak]], to consider how far the state should go when imposing restrictions on places of worship. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/supreme-court/supreme-court-declines-take-pandemic-restrictions-worship-services-n1255534?cid=sm_npd_nn_fb_ma (NBC News)]
*[[Second impeachment trial of Donald Trump]]
**The [[Impeachment in the United_States#Articles of impeachment|article of impeachment]] for former [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] is brought to the [[United States Senate]], officially triggering the trial, which is scheduled to begin on February 8. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/politics/politics-live-updates-impeachment-article-heads-to-the-senate-sarah-huckabee-sanders-to-run-for-ark-governor/ar-BB1d4NUd (MSN)]
*[[Transgender personnel in the United States military]]
**[[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]] repeals the [[First presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]]'s [[Presidential Memorandum on Military Service by Transgender Individuals (2018)|decision]] to ban [[history of transgender people in the United States|transgender people]] from serving in the [[United States Armed Forces|United States military]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2021/jan/25/transgender-military-ban-biden-repeal-trump-rule (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Nineteen people are found dead in two vehicles in [[Camargo Municipality, Tamaulipas|Camargo]], [[Tamaulipas]], near the [[Mexico–United States border]]. The victims, who were likely [[undocumented migrant]]s, were shot and then set on fire. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-55796376 (BBC News)]
*[[Aftermath of the January 6 United States Capitol attack|Aftermath of the 2021 storming of the United States Capitol]]
**Brandon Straka, the [[WalkAway campaign|WalkAway]] movement founder and "[[Attempts to overturn the 2020 United States presidential election#Stop the Steal|Stop the Steal]]" activist who spoke at a rally held by pro-Trump supporters, is arrested on a felony charge of interfering with police during the [[January 6 United States Capitol attack|storming]] of the [[United States Capitol]]. [https://www.politico.com/news/2021/01/25/capitol-riot-stop-the-steal-462322 (''Politico'')]
*[[Adass Israel School sex abuse scandal]]
**Malka Leifer, the former [[Head teacher|school principal]] facing 74 charges of [[Child sexual abuse in Australia|child sexual abuse]], is [[Extradition|extradited]] to [[Melbourne]], Australia following a six-year delay of the case that allowed for her to be a [[fugitive]] in Israel. [https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20210125-israel-deports-child-abuse-suspect-to-australia-after-6-year-legal-battle (AFP via France 24)]
*A driver rams pedestrians with his vehicle during a series of hit-and-runs attack in [[Portland, Oregon]], killing a person and injuring five others. [https://www.oregonlive.com/news/2021/01/pedestrian-seriously-injured-in-southeast-portland-incident.html (''Oregon Live'')]
*Two Swedish filmmakers, who filmed the wreck of the [[MS Estonia|MS ''Estonia'']] that sank in 1994 for a documentary, face [[Judiciary of Sweden|trial]] for violating a treaty that [[MS Estonia#Protection of the wreck|prohibits visiting the site]]. [https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2021/0125/1191859-estonia-ferry/ (AFP via RTE)]
*The [[House of Commons of Canada|Canada House of Commons]] votes to call on [[Prime Minister of Canada|Prime Minister]] [[Justin Trudeau]] to label the [[Proud Boys]] as a terrorist organization. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-01-25/parliament-calls-for-trudeau-to-list-proud-boys-as-terror-group (Bloomberg)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Italian government crisis]]
**[[Prime Minister of Italy|Prime Minister]] [[Giuseppe Conte]] is set to hand in his resignation tomorrow, due to an ongoing [[political crisis]] which began on January 13. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-55802611 (BBC News)]
*[[Politics of Estonia]]
**[[Kaja Kallas]] wins the support of the [[Riigikogu]] to become the new [[Prime Minister of Estonia|Prime Minister]], the first woman to do so. [https://news.err.ee/1608085663/gallery-kaja-kallas-wins-mandate-to-form-government (ERR)]
*[[Cabinet of Joe Biden]]
**The [[United States Senate]] votes 84–15 to confirm [[Janet Yellen]] as [[United States Secretary of the Treasury|Treasury Secretary]], making her the first woman to serve as head of the [[United States Department of the Treasury|Treasury Department]]. [https://www.marketwatch.com/story/janet-yellen-wins-senate-confirmation-as-treasury-secretary-11611617899 (''MarketWatch'')]
